page.overview:
What is Nenuial?

Lake Evendim, or Nenuial, was a lake in northern Eriador, the largest body of water between Belegaer the Great Sea and the Misty Mountains.

It was about 100 miles north of the Shire. It was approximately fifty miles from north to south, and twenty miles east to west. It was bounded on the west and south by the Hills of Evendim. On its southern shore was Annúminas, the first capital of Arnor, the north Realm in Exile.

The Brandywine River flowed eastward out of this lake.

Lake Evendim has no role in any of the extant stories of Middle-earth, but is mentioned occasionally in the Appendices to .
